Are you looking for the perfect evening job? Do you want to easily combine work with your studies,
family, or hobbies? 🌟 And earn some great extra cash with evening surcharges up to 40%? BAM! 💥
Come work as a part-time logistics employee at PostNL in Nieuwegein! 🚀

What we offer
- A great base salary of €14.99 gross per hour 💵
- You will be part of a diverse team
- Evening allowance up to 40% on top of your salary!
- Opportunities to become assistant team leader
- A varied location with multiple departments 🏢
- Chance to get a direct contract with PostNL 📝

Who you are
To keep the warehouse running smoothly, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a
logistics employee:

- You speak and understand English and/or Dutch well; 🗣️
- You are available for 3 to 4 days a week for the evening shift;
- You have your own transport to commute to Nieuwegein at night. 🌜

What will you do
As a part-time logistics employee, your shift starts between 16:30 and 19:30. ⏱️ Perfect, because that
leaves your days completely free! Together with your colleagues, you ensure all incoming packages
are ready for departure. 📦 You will be walking and lifting a lot. What exactly will you do?

- You help unload trucks that have just arrived;
- You scan packages and sort them super fast by postal code; 🏡
- You load the roll containers and prepare them for the drivers.

Where will you work
Welcome to PostNL in Nieuwegein! This is the place where thousands of packages pass through every
day. It is a dynamic environment where there is always something to do. 🏃‍♀️‍➡️ Many of your colleagues are
also s​tudents or work part-time. Between all the hard work, there is always room for a joke. 🤜

Job application
Ready to earn great money? Apply directly via the button! 🖱️I will contact you within one working day. ☎️
Do you have any questions? You can always call or app us. Let's goooo!  Uiteraard staat deze vacature open voor iedereen die zich hierin herkent.

• Assisting with the installation and replacement of glass 
• Learning glazing techniques from experienced colleagues 
• Working on residential, commercial, and historic buildings 
• Using hand tools and basic equipment safely 
• Supporting a variety of glazing projects on-site 
As a junior glazier, you will join a team of approximately 25 colleagues. The team consists of both younger and more experienced employees, creating a supportive environment where everyone helps each other. Dutch and English are spoken within the company.

You work independently on your tasks, while also being part of a team. Quality is important. That is why you carefully check whether the product has been assembled according to the drawing and specifications. What are the working hours? 
You will work in a day shift. You start between 06:00 and 07:00 and work 8 hours a day. Who are you? 
For this position, we are looking for someone who already has experience in a technical environment. You do not need to know everything, but a good technical foundation is important. You: - Have experience with technical assembly, mechanical assembly or metalworking - Can read and understand technical drawings - Are comfortable working with power tools and hand tools - Work accurately and pay attention to quality - Can work independently and also work well with colleagues - Speak enough Dutch or English to understand work and safety instructions - Are available full-time - Can apply for a Certificate of Conduct (VOG), if required for the position It is a plus if you: - Have experience in the defence, aviation or high-tech industry - Have experience with welding, spot welding or other joining techniques - Are familiar with quality and safety procedures in a production environment Do you have experience in assembly as well as welding or other metalworking techniques? Be sure to let us know. There are different technical job opportunities available within VDL.
